target.statement: NDCG@10 for TAI2Vec-Cont on MovieLens-100k = 0.0805 (vs Item2Vec 0.0575, +40.17%)

compute.basis: MovieLens-100k is tiny (100k interactions, 943 users) and the model is a lightweight skip-gram with negative sampling; the main cost is implementing the TAI2Vec-Cont weighting from the paper (code repo may be incomplete) and running a small hyperparameter grid (alpha, Wmin, epochs) on CPU.

blockers: Repository may not contain the exact TAI2Vec-Cont implementation or tuned configs; paper describes the method but not all code details
Hyperparameter grid (alpha in {3,5}, Wmin in {0.3,0.5}, epochs in {20,50,100}, etc.) must be re-run to match the reported number
Exact preprocessing (binarization midpoint, filtering) must be inferred from text
title: Learning Behaviorally Grounded Item Embeddings via Personalized Temporal Contexts
